top_creatures.label: Floating eye disc
top_creatures.why: floating sphere that closes in; readable at 375 px (not checked)
top_creatures.keep: float with no gravity; close-in approach

top_creatures.label: Ember skull dasher
top_creatures.keep: flying ram; minion that is not a counted kill

top_creatures.label: Soul-spawner floater
top_creatures.keep: summon under a cap; blocked summon dies at once
top_creatures.change: own look; fix the cap (off by one)

top_creatures.label: Resurrector caster
top_creatures.why: raises fallen allies; strong many-on-one threat
top_creatures.keep: corpse raise by scanning ahead of its move

top_creatures.label: Shadow stalker
top_creatures.why: fuzzy target that makes ranged aim less accurate
top_creatures.change: own translucent shimmer; own jitter amount

top_creatures.label: Armoured colossus
top_creatures.why: boss with rocket-style attacks and a low pain chance
top_creatures.keep: low flinch on a big body

top_creatures.label: Bone missile skeleton
top_creatures.why: skeleton with a homing missile type
top_creatures.keep: homing missile (tracer object type MT_TRACER, by name)

gear_tiers.pool: timed powers: invulnerability, berserk, invisibility, radiation suit, computer map, light amplification

zones.name: hellslime sector
zones.traits: 10 damage every 32 tics; blocked by suit

zones.name: nukage sector
zones.traits: 5 damage every 32 tics; blocked by suit

zones.name: strobe and super hellslime
zones.traits: 20 damage every 32 tics; suit leaves 5 in 256 chance

zones.name: secret sector
zones.traits: counts a secret; clears the special

zones.name: exit super-damage
zones.traits: 20 damage every 32 tics; exits when health 10 or less

zones.name: light effects (four)
zones.traits: fire flicker, light flash, strobe, glow

looks.label: full-bright first frame
looks.technique: emissive frame flag (32768) for impacts and flashes

looks.label: fuzz for shadow monsters
looks.technique: translucent shimmer plus aim jitter about 22 degrees at most

looks.label: colour translation
looks.technique: one sprite, many palette-translated colour variants

looks.label: blood and puff chains
looks.technique: short state chains per effect; blood three frames at 8 tics

looks.label: weapon four-state chain
looks.technique: ready, lower, raise, fire, with a separate flash sprite

looks.label: flinch on random roll
looks.technique: pain state only when a random roll passes painchance

originals.name: Corpse raiser that walks the field
originals.idea: scan ahead of the move for corpses within a bounded radius, and raise one
originals.change: our look, timing and cooldown; fix the scan to a bounded cell radius

originals.name: Capped summoner
originals.idea: summon only under a cap; a summon blocked by a wall dies at once
originals.keep: the cap and the blocked-summon rule
originals.change: our look; live counter with >= instead of a full scan

originals.name: Fuzzy-target stalker
originals.idea: shadow targets get an aim penalty
originals.change: our shimmer and a smaller jitter (for example 8 degrees)

originals.name: Per-monster flinch rate
originals.idea: each monster has a pain chance; bosses flinch least

originals.name: Reverse-frame raise
originals.idea: a raise chain that plays the death frames backwards

originals.name: Suit-gated hazard tick
originals.idea: a floor tick every 32 tics that a suit can block
originals.keep: periodic tick gated by a suit

originals.name: Armour pool with absorb fraction
originals.idea: a pool absorbs one third (light) or one half (heavy) until it runs out

originals.name: Light modes as zone data
originals.idea: flicker, flash, strobe and glow as data on a zone
originals.keep: four light modes as zone data
originals.change: our palette and rates; fix the flash mask (mask 64 gives only 1 or 65 tics)

originals.name: Priority-tagged cues
originals.idea: each sound cue has a priority number so loud cues win
